rulings.Q1: ACCEPT. CI-A3-a places the charged F/D comparison before resolution and allocation, exempting Directory(""). A funded absent-kind request executes exactly one edge; an exhausted charge stops before its operation. CI-A3-b explicitly counts refusal prefixes: no final-member work before resolution, at most S + 1 lookups and S hop temporaries bounded by Q-hat, and resolved-member work bounded by the requested-kind maxima. Latched calls execute no charged work. Thus E_launch <= B-hat_launch covers successful and refused runs. CI-T28 includes the original file-plus-link/no-directory counterexample and independent accounting.
rulings.Q2: ACCEPT. The first failure of launch_member or transfer, including Budget, latches the capability. Later calls on any scope refuse before charging or observing, with latched Budget yielding Budget(Closed). This matches pinned CI-2-r2 retained_tree.rs:151,167,422-428. Binding joins the latched causes. CI-T27 requires an exhausted launch followed by both launch and transfer on a fresh funded scope, with unchanged used and no observation.
